reason: Implementing one card against a bounded set of profile-supported gate classes. This is the surface the reduced profile was measured for, and the only one it may be handed to.

CI runs the whole required gate set, including the site standards, site and contract unit, generated-document and reading-level families that read across the excluded byte-heavy trees. CI is unchanged by this card and continues to provision the full checkout.
test/*.test.mjs and test/contract/*.test.mjs read tracked builder inputs across site/data, data/ and entity_resolution/, which the reduced profile deliberately defers.
They serve the built site, which requires the generated Pages build over the complete tracked payload.
The Pages build and the served-artifact checks read the complete tracked site payload and the tracked artifacts/ tree.
A deployment publishes the built site and the Worker bundle. Provisioning a deployment from anything but the full control would make the published artifact depend on a development convenience.
Release evidence is derived from the full tracked tree and from generated build output.
The reconciliation run projects and publishes evidence over the whole declared architecture surface, not one --check invocation, and its output is an artifact other work is judged against.

The RCP-03 evidence-placement receipt was measured reading 3,535 tracked paths totalling 615.4 MiB, close to the whole tracked tree, and the per-tree inputs it derives from span every documentation tree.

Producing or placing evidence reads and writes across documentation trees the reduced profile defers, and an evidence receipt taken in a partial working copy would record an incomplete tree as if it were the tree.

Declared explicitly by a caller that needs history beyond what its checkout carries. The default reduced profile keeps complete history, so this normally costs nothing extra; it is declared full because a caller that says it needs complete history must not be handed a checkout whose history depends on a profile option.

gate class "site-standards" is full-checkout-only: The standards suite walks the whole tracked site tree, including the excluded site/data, site/agencies and site/media payloads.
gate class "site-unit" is full-checkout-only: test/*.test.mjs and test/contract/*.test.mjs read tracked builder inputs across site/data, data/ and entity_resolution/.
gate class "generated-source-docs" is full-checkout-only: The owning builders read and rewrite tracked projections across the excluded trees.
gate class "evidence-placement" is full-checkout-only: Measured to read 3,535 tracked paths totalling 615.4 MiB, which is close to the whole tracked tree.
gate class "reading-level" is full-checkout-only: Walks the served site documents, which the profile does not materialise.
gate class "accessibility-browser" is full-checkout-only: They serve the built site, which requires the generated Pages build over the full tracked payload.
gate class "pages-build" is full-checkout-only: The Cloudflare Pages build reads the complete tracked site payload.
gate class "release-surface" is full-checkout-only: Release evidence is derived from the full tracked tree and from generated build output.

gate class "full-history-guards" is full-checkout-only: A depth-limited profile cannot supply a merge base. The default card profile keeps complete commit history for exactly this reason; the opt-in --depth variant must be unshallowed first.

gate class "cutover-receipt" is full-checkout-only: It asserts that every retained evidence projection resolves on disk, and it does so with an existence check rather than a content read. CI-09's recorder deliberately records only content reads, because recording metadata probes grew the closure to the whole tracked tree, so this gate's true closure was never observed. Its retained set reaches into site/data, warehouse/ and docs/screenshots, which the profile defers, and it was measured failing in a reduced checkout at this revision.
